settings.refresh_seconds.label: Refresh seconds
settings.refresh_seconds.description: How often the NATS KV value is read. The usage API is only hit when KV has nothing fresh.

settings.credentials_path.description: Claude Code credentials JSON holding the OAuth access token, used when falling back to the usage API.

settings.nats_url.description: NATS server holding the claude-usage KV bucket.
